name: 55959 · Minn City, MN
findings: ZIP 55959 (Minn City) has 8 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (75%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55959 (Minn City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55959 (Minn City) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
